subject: history
concept: Exploring a medieval civilization outside of Europe (e.g. Mali, China, or the Islamic Golden Age) and its achievements
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student examines illustrated achievements (architecture, scholarship, trade wealth) from a studied non-European medieval civilization
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an achievement to the civilization responsible for it
exercise.abstract: Student describes one significant achievement of the studied civilization

misconception_flags: assumes the medieval period only involved European history

interest_binding: civilization or angle generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where possible
